The quiet hours after sunset

By A. Writer · 6 min read

Dusk is the part of twilight that ends when the sun is six degrees below the horizon. Reading in that light is easier when pages follow along, which is what this fixture checks: plain paragraphs, links like this one, and some inline code.

Light is a matter of degree; so is darkness.

Most articles are this simple. A white body, near-black text, a few grey rules and the occasional highlighted note. Every color here is a literal in the stylesheet, so the CSS rewrite sees all of them.

function dusk() {
  return "themed";
}
Note: amber callouts must stay readable and keep their hue.

Closing paragraph with emphasis, strong text and a final link.
